notes: DEMONSTRATION ONLY. No real forecast was committed; no seller contacted; probability is illustrative and uncalibrated.

forecasts.question: If 10 consenting eligible sellers are actually contacted by the expiry date, will at least one make a documented >=$20 deposit for a 5-listing authenticity audit by 2027-01-31?
forecasts.outcome_definition: Binary: 1 only if 10 eligible contacted sellers and >=1 verifiable $20+ deposit by deadline. If outreach/eligibility threshold fails, mark VOID with receipt, never score as a demand failure.
forecasts.population: Hypothetical 10 consenting independent Etsy handmade sellers targeted with permission; not selected or contacted
forecasts.falsifier: Among 10 eligible contacted sellers, zero documented >=$20 deposits by settlement date counts as outcome 0. Outreach not completed is VOID, not 0.

reference_class.description: No trustworthy prior sample of identical offer, targeting, and contact channel; outside-view baseline unknown
reference_class.selection_bias: Self-selected marketplaces and outreach could overstate willingness to pay

hypotheses.explanation: Sellers value an audit and can afford a paid deposit
hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Eligible sellers view demo and decline price even after clear deliverable

hypotheses.explanation: Sellers have a real need but prefer free platform resources
hypotheses.disconfirming_test: A seller requests paid manual handling rather than readily available free guidance

hypotheses.explanation: Rule changes do not materially affect this particular seller category
hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Review exact current policy and affected product categories for sampled sellers

position.bottleneck_owner: Etsy listing rules and merchant access remain under platform/seller control
position.our_position: Outside service provider; can only audit seller-authorized data
position.can_be_bypassed: Yes: sellers may use free guides, in-house staff, or competing auditors
position.value_capture: Fee for time saved and well-documented review, if willingness to pay is shown

decay.why_gap_remains: Policy transition and seller-specific auditing effort (hypothesis only)
decay.erosion_trigger: Platform documentation improves, seller tools automate audit, or buyer trust returns

forecasts.evidence_plan: Record policy revision and category exceptions; with contact permission collect exact outreach, replies, deposits/refunds and completed audits
